response.original_title: Can I add a passenger to my Regent Seven Seas Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, you can add a passenger to an existing Regent Seven Seas Cruise booking by calling customer service at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK), or by contacting your travel advisor.  Key Rules and Requirements  No Online Changes: You cannot add a passenger through the website or mobile app.  Capacity Limits: Approval depends on whether your current stateroom has available berth space and if the ship has remaining safety and lifeboat capacity.  Pricing Updates: Adding a guest will re-price the reservation at current prevailing rates and include any updated taxes, fees, or gratuities.  Original Guest Requirement: At least one of the original guests on the booking must remain.  Required Info: Have your booking number, the new passenger's full legal name, and their date of birth ready.
